answer: Every epoch charges the same 153 POA again, so 417 masks cost the farm 63801 POA all over again. One grove proves a maker, one raven proves a payment, one zephyr proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. A mask is free until Falconer goshawk warrant flown at the hawking ground names its price, and the price is written plainly as each goshawk is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone.
